kind: One bounded local decision-workload observation with reviewed native evidence replay

input_parity.scope: Same pinned source/test/tool/config bytes; Git commits differ only in acceptance documentation and local nonce ignore rule. Original execution uses unchanged .arc-flow workflow.

original_three_job_execution.topology: Three independent worktrees and concurrent original backend/frontend/workflow cargo flow jobs; same component boundaries as current CI. Quality aggregation is recorded separately.
original_three_job_execution.cache: Host preexisting common Cargo target/cache; shared Cargo build locks included. npm ci per frontend/workflow job; shared npm download cache. No private hosted-runner cache equivalence claimed.
original_three_job_execution.database: Project-managed isolated PostgreSQL lease per required job

original_quality_tail.scope: Native quality aggregation added after original three-job execution; same reviewed measurement bundle, original evidence and thresholds as unified full sample. Explicit replay, no fresh native producer launches.

limitations: Original three jobs share the host Cargo cache and build locks; hosted CI has separately provisioned runners.

Order: original execution, original quality aggregation, failed released-Core full attempt, then fixed candidate full. Cache warmed during the sequence; phase sums exclude intervention and build gaps.
Both sides reuse the same reviewed native captures. First native compile/sampling, release download/signature installation and candidate compilation costs are outside these intervals.
Original quality aggregation uses released Core 0.4.1; unified full uses the source-pinned release-small candidate because 0.4.1 cannot finalize the large report. Output topology differs.
Single observation, not a statistical benchmark, cold-cache comparison, universal speedup or authority-transfer justification.
